title: FOX One Deal: Here’s How to Save 30% Off a Streaming Subscription
summary: Our guide to livestream FOX, FS1 and FS2 to livestream 2026 FIFA World Cup matches at home.
contentText:

FOX, FS1 and FS2 have become a hub for some of the biggest sports, including FIFA World Cup . For 2026, all of the soccer matches can be found across the FOX Sports family of networks throughout the entire international tournament.

And right now, you can get FOX One , FOX’s new streaming service, as a Prime Video on-add channel for $13.99 per month for three months (reg. $19.99 per month) — that’s a 30% savings.

$13.99/month $19.99/month 30% off

Get FOX One on Prime Video

How to Watch FOX Sports Online for Free

There are a few live TV streamers that have FOX, FS1 and FS2, so you can catch soccer matches for little to no money. Below, ShopBillboard put together a few live TV streaming options with free trials and promos that’ll let you watch FOX Sports online without cable.

FOX One

Prime Video add-on channel

Prime Day deal expires on Friday (June 26).

On sale for $13.99 per month for three months (regularly $19.99 per month), as a Prime Video add-on streaming channel, FOX One features every network under the FOX umbrella, including FOX, FOX Sports, FS2, FOX News, FOX Business, FOX Nation, FOX Weather, FOX Deportes and Big Ten Network.

FOX One is one of the best ways to watch all World Cup matches for 30% off per month.

FREE TRIAL

DirecTV

Get Five-Day Free Trial

FuboTV

FuboTV will give new users a five-day free trial . With prices starting at $63.99 for the first month of service ($88.99 per month afterward), each plan comes with FOX in 4K definition, as well as FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes — along with access to the FOX One streaming service. You’ll be able to watch over 200 channels with 1,000 hours of DVR and the option to stream on 10 devices at once.

Hulu + Live TV

Get three-day free trial

Hulu + Live TV including ABC.

Get the most content options including the option to watch FOX, FS1 and FS2 with Hulu + Live TV . Not only will you get more than 90 live TV channels, but access to the entire Hulu library including exclusive content, originals and programming. A regular subscription price starts at $89.99 per month.

In addition, Hulu offers music programming and documentaries, such as Summer of Soul , It’s All Country , Road Diary: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band and others. It even livestreams some of the most popular music festivals, like Lollapalooza, Bonnaroo, iHeartRadio Festival, iHeartCountry Festival and Austin City Limits Music Fest.

As an added bonus, Hulu + Live TV is automatically bundled with Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited .
